item.tib: gsang chen seng ge sgra sgrags las drag sgrub ka ma li yi tsa kra
item.coloph: yul rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi zhing khams/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal nas lcags lug zla tshes bzang por / rigs mthun bde chen Dak+ki'i grogs bgyis te zab mo'i gter rgya gnyen po bkrol nas gang khug tu sba bar byas/ slar lo bdun gyi bka' rgya yol ba'i tshe shar rdza 'ja' lus pa g.yung drung 'chang chen pos khri skyongs blo gros rgya mtsho dang / stag zhig drang srong seng ge nyi ma/ dbra sprul dri med 'od zer/ nyi sprul bstan 'dzin mchog rgyal/ khro dbon yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ pad sprul bstan 'dzin nyi ma bzang po/ rigs sras 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros/ zer 'phro bla ma rnam rgyal tshul khrims/ gcod pa skal bzang g.yung drung / rnal 'byor tshul khrims dbang rgyal sogs lta spyod zung 'brel gyi sgom grwa / bsnyen sgrub las brtson gyi sgrub grwa/ tshad gsum zung 'brel gyi bshad grwa / dgag bzhag spang sgrub kyi rtsod grwa bcas shar rdza'i 'dus spyi yongs rdzogs nas/ zab gter rin po che ma lus pa bstan 'gro'i btsas su smin dgos tshul gyi gsol ba yang yang btab pa dang / se ra mkha' 'gro su kha sing+hi nas kyang zab gter phab dgos zhu ba gnur lce byung ba'i rkyen las/ kho bo hUM chen 'gro 'dul gling pas shog ser las ma 'gags brda yi ri mo shar bzhin drung yig pa seng ge nyi ma/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ rnam rgyal tshul khrims/tshul khrims dbang rgyal bzhi yi rna lam dus gcig tu bsgrags te sgrab skor cha tshang gdan thog gcig tu phab zin pa dge des ris bral rgyal bstan 'phel zhing rgyas te snyigs ma'i rgud pa ma lus gzhil cing bstan 'gro'i bde skyid kyi snang ba 'phel ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur bar shog cig/
